items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: after I quit with Menev, that is after he retired from playing.

ctx.x: I was just about 16 then. 16. And then after I quit with Menev, that is after he retired from playing. He retired to teach.
He doesn't teach you. I think it's in the 20s. That's right. It's the early 20s, I think.
